# A3 poster layout

The garden logo sits top-centre at 25 mm diameter. Large friendly type stays legible from two metres, with the open day date in the header band.

goal.intended_outcome: A printable A3 poster the committee can send to the print shop
goal.objective: Design a spring campaign poster for the neighbourhood garden open day

scenario: a complete spec satisfies the constraints; no confirmed findings may fire
